contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night stone lanes, bakery/café fronts and pale stucco doorways under warm street lamps; no rain depicted (reflective paving is not rain); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: User explicitly approved these five editorials (01 v2, 02, 03, 04 v2, 05 v2) and the full automation (2026-11-02, Claude Code publication). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: Rear view: the jacket front and the blouse front/body are conservative reconstructions (only the back, collar and hem show). Hidden soles and the opposite shoe are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 25 products viewed on all four backgrounds. Full silhouettes, no baked opaque rectangles, no visible edge halos or clipping. Clothing/shoe colors and construction agree with approved editorials; hidden areas conservatively reconstructed as documented. Shoe pairs top-down and aligned. No scene props included.

copy.titleEn: ONE MORE LOOK AT THE DOOR

title.en: One more look at the door
title.de: Noch ein Blick an der Tür

deck.ko: 초콜릿 재킷과 네이비 팬츠, 뒤돌아보는 순간의 균형.
deck.en: Chocolate and navy find balance in a turn back.
deck.de: Schokoladenbraun und Marineblau im Gleichgewicht der Drehung.

intro.ko: 열쇠를 돌리다 카메라 쪽으로 한 번 웃어 보이는 짧은 인사입니다.
intro.en: She turns the key, then offers the camera one last quick smile.
intro.de: Sie dreht den Schlüssel und schenkt der Kamera noch ein kurzes Lächeln.

body.ko: 초콜릿색 쇼트 재킷 아래 에크루 블라우스의 칼라와 밑단이 밝게 드러납니다. 짧은 재킷과 높은 팬츠 허리선이 뒤돌아선 몸의 선을 길게 이어 줍니다. 둥근 검정 발레 플랫은 문턱 앞의 작은 움직임에 어울리는 단정한 마무리입니다. 등 쪽 절개와 팬츠의 곧은 실루엣이 이 장면의 착장을 설명합니다.
body.en: The ecru blouse shows at the collar and below the chocolate short jacket. A high trouser waist and short jacket keep the turned silhouette long. Round black ballet flats give the small movement at the doorstep a neat finish. Back seams and the straight trouser line tell the outfit’s story from this angle.
body.de: Die Ecrubluse zeigt sich am Kragen und unter der kurzen schokoladenbraunen Jacke. Hohe Hosentaille und kurze Jacke halten die gedrehte Silhouette lang. Runde schwarze Ballerinas geben der kleinen Bewegung vor der Tür einen klaren Abschluss. Rückennähte und die gerade Hosenlinie erzählen das Outfit aus diesem Winkel.

pull.en: Proportion that holds through a turn.
pull.de: Proportionen, die auch in der Drehung stimmen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Proportion that holds through a turn.

tip.ko: 에크루 밑단을 조금 남겨 짙은 두 색 사이에 간격을 만드세요.
tip.en: Leave a little ecru hem visible to separate the two dark colors.
tip.de: Etwas Ecrusaum sichtbar lassen, um die beiden dunklen Farben zu trennen.

description.ko: 짧은 밑단과 칼라, 짙은 소매 단추.
description.en: Short hem, collar and dark cuff buttons.
description.de: Kurzer Saum, Kragen und dunkle Ärmelknöpfe.

howToWear.en: Let a little ecru blouse show below the short hem to keep the layers visible from behind.
